steps.assistant_text: Retrospective verified source port onto frozen upstream. Independent native C, original USO identities, both raw modes, full ROM, six strict code-block payloads and no exact/raw/partial regression pass. Canonical and remote branches untouched.

analysis.purpose: Deserialize two stream words, construct an object, wire it into the self/child state, append it to an attachment context and store it in an imported indexed table. Exact classes, stream/table application roles and flag meaning remain uncertain.
analysis.observed_abi: a0 is self, retained in s0; frame 38 saves s0/ra. Both stream reads advance a cursor by 4 and store the current word at self04. The first signed word triggers a diagnostic at >=4 and remains the final table index; the second word is a constructor argument. No deliberate function return value is established; void C is ABI-compatible, not proof of the original declaration.

calls.observed_abi: a0=self; result unconsumed. Callee checks self->0x3C->0x0C.
a0=data+0x2C538, a1=first word, a2=second word (zero on this path); result unconsumed.
a0=0, a1=self+0x14 word, a2=second stream word; v0 returns an object pointer. Callee allocates 0x98 bytes and stores a2 at +0x90.
a0=attachment context+0x10, a1=new object pointer represented as a word; result unconsumed. Reuses existing List66620 typing.

evidence: Recovered the real 260-byte exact source from historical scratch/byte-exact-body.c, not the stale source left in that workspace. Fresh original IDO 7.1 -O2 -mips2 -32 normal/NM C equals SHA256 fe9e928dd2dd239d1ad9bc2fd5374fed0547f90ecf6e58ed777f3334eaa22035. Declaration order, address-taken first count and original expression trees are preserved; no flags or instructions were forced.

Original bootup USO export Sym688 is Text 7D280 (game_libs logical 68C14); its 260-byte ROM body equals immutable expected. All five original JAL relocations are audited: Sym2206/435/306/2503/144 map respectively to 55298/334B0/61478/695F4/66674. Literal distinct C aliases preserve every identity; ignored return declarations remain unknown.

Data-base Sym2 is D_00653C and supplies diagnostic addends 2C4F4/2C508/2C538. The final indexed store instead uses import Sym557, cached RAM name import_000616A0, original class 82. It is retained as gl_68C14_table, separate from DataSym2; no BSS classification or resolved table meaning is asserted. Six new aliases are zero-only and retain the original identity partition.

Original ASM/expected/ROM contain a 4-byte zero gap before the function. Previous 68BF4 owns 28 bytes and 68C14 owns 260. Expected .NON_MATCHING is an OBJECT marker 264 covering pad+body, not extra function ownership. A simple align8 cannot preserve both pipelines: their missing-gap function addresses have different mod8 alignment. IDO rejects the tested global asm alignment declaration; the primary SGI align_symbol documentation describes variables, not a proven function directive.

restore-zero-gap copies only the immutable expected 4-byte zero gap outside both FUNC extents, after requiring both adjacent function bodies/sizes to match. It rejects nonzero padding, changed bodies and overlapping FUNC ownership, recognizes only the exact ASM OBJECT marker, preserves all existing text payloads/sizes and moves later symbols/relocation sites with their bytes. Eight focused tests pass for payload/sizes, relocations, marker handling, idempotence and negative cases. No expected, ASM, instruction or relocation identity is edited.

Shared AttachmentPrefix at04/14 is adopted across 4E888/4E8D4/4E920/525F0/68C14. All eight sibling normal/NM bodies retain canonical bytes, including the historical partial 525F0 NM body; no partial is promoted. Pinned IDO O32 layout check establishes size 18 and offsets 04/14; complete class and flag meaning remain unknown. Existing List66620 is reused for the append argument.

Private Ghidra supports the two cursor advances, diagnostics, constructor result wiring, append, attachment flag/parent update and indexed store. Original USO sites, not collapsed jal0 names, establish call/data identities. No recovered caller or relocated pointer into the function/pad was found by the recorded audit; unknown entry/reachability gaps remain unknown.

6000 bounded relocation-aware original-MIPS cases agree with a model using two distinct abstract data/import bases and per-site hooks. Hooks mutate stream cursor, self constructor argument, child/context, attachment and final self18 pointer; tests check reloads, saved first index, both diagnostic conditions, all five call arguments, constructor wiring, both attachment paths, final indexed store, caller-saved clobbers and frame restoration. The constructor result is assumed nonnull; modeled negative indices do not establish a valid real table extent.

Normal/NM, full byte-identical ROM and all six blocks pass. All 6605 available unassigned function-mode bodies equal canonical, including the predecessor whose 28-byte ownership is unchanged. Prior exacts and missing 6B048 NM are handled by the standard raw gates. The zero gap adds no matched bytes; the gain is only 260.

Fresh upstream port: original compiler in both modes, complete native call/data USO identity checks, exact source-generated tables/constants, exact host function bytes, full ROM and all six strict original code-block payloads.
